alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a table. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left looking at a plate with four little bites. One by one the bites vanish with soft pops while the figure leans in, content. After the fourth, its eyes go wide and then it narrows its eyes at the camera, next to an empty plate. The text stays: me having just one, there were four.
